# Zyene Reviews

> AI-powered review management for local businesses - monitor Google reviews, automate requests, route negative feedback privately, and reply with AI.

## What the product does

- Review page: customers scan a QR code or tap an NFC review stand, rate the visit, pick what they liked, and get an AI-drafted review they can edit, copy, and post on Google themselves. Lower ratings go to a private feedback form.
- QR codes (print or download) and NFC review stands ordered inside the app.
- Reviews inbox for Google, Facebook, and Yelp with AI reply suggestions (Professional, Friendly, Concise).
- Automatic replies to new Google reviews by star threshold (3+, 4+, or 5 only) and tone.
- Review requests by SMS, email, or both; customer list with notes and CSV import/export; campaigns with Post-Visit, Appointment Follow-up, and Re-engagement templates.
- Smart Insights: key themes from reviews and suggested improvements; broken-link checks on the Google Business Profile.
- Analytics: new reviews, average rating, response rate, request funnel by channel, PDF and CSV export.
- Competitors: rating and review volume comparison, Google search terms, AI market positioning brief, threshold alerts, recent competitor events.
- Google SEO & AEO: Google profile score and audit, prompt tracking across AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, share of voice, llms.txt and NAP directory tools.
- Website review widgets (20 templates), REST API, Zapier-compatible webhooks, Square (early access).
- Multi-location: one organization, many businesses. Plans: Starter $29.99/mo (1 location), Professional $59.99/mo (3 locations), Enterprise (custom).
